thread:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: streaming p99 spike on /v1/stream (us-west-2). Auto-detected correlated increase in ECC correctable counts on gpu-3a (node gpupool-usw2-47). Investigating. Paging on-call. :rotating_light:
Alice_SRE: I'm on. seeing p95->~550ms, p99 ~4.2s for streaming in dashboards. Affected service: hosted-api, model-route: gantry-13 (long-context). Starting live triage.
Jane_runtime: I see continuous batching backlog building at the runtime level, lots of blocked kernel queues. Logs show repeated NVML ECC_CORRECTABLE increments on GPU 0 of that node.
Mike_hw: GPU telemetry: temp peaks 88C, fan at 90%, clocks dropping intermittently (thermal-throttle). Also gpu driver reported 'ECC_CORRECTABLE_FLAP' twice in last 10m.
Laura_support: Support: we have 3 customer complaints about partial streaming stalls and one timed-out stream (retry failed). I filed a provisional support note to customers impacted list.
Alice_SRE: Quick mitigation plan: 1) cordon + drain node 2) route new requests away from node 3) fallback to quantized-gantry-13 as lower mem profile for new traffic 4) followup hw diagnostics. Executing now.
Jane_runtime: Preparing drain steps. Will set router policy to exclude node-id gpupool-usw2-47 and reduce batch_size for gantry-13 to 8 to lower queuing. Also enable explicit KV prefix cache short-circuit to reduce token stalls.
infra-bot: Router update requested: exclude-node gpupool-usw2-47 for route gantry-13. Change enacted in 12s.
Alice_SRE: Running drain: 
```
kubectl cordon node/gpupool-usw2-47
kubectl -n inference drain node/gpupool-usw2-47 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```
Alice_SRE: Eviction started. Estimated evict time ~ 45s (streaming handoffs increase time).
Mike_hw: While we drain, do NOT reboot driver yet — driver reload risks KV cache invalidation and will amplify p99. Prefer graceful HW handoff then cold-swap after peak.
Jane_runtime: Router is routing new streaming sessions to gpupool-usw2-31/gpupool-usw2-12 (alt nodes). Canary traffic to quantized model set at 25% for gantry-13. Batch size lowered. Early metrics: p95 dropping to ~220ms, p99 to ~1.4s for redirected traffic.
Alice_SRE: Good. Observed kernel-level logs snippet: 
```
[ 12:43:07 ] nvmlDeviceGetCorrectableErrorCount(0) -> 42
[ 12:43:15 ] nvmlDeviceGetTemperature(0) -> 88C
[ 12:43:29 ] therm_throttle: active
[ 12:44:03 ] nvmlDeviceGetCorrectableErrorCount(0) -> 50
```
Mike_hw: Looks like a flaky DIMM/GPU memory channel causing repeated correctables that correlate with thermal spikes. Plan: after drain, power-cycle the board and run memtest logs + vendor diag. Will schedule a hot-swap if errors persist.
Laura_support: Posted incident note to status page: "Partial streaming degradation in US-WEST-2; mitigation in progress. Some customers may see increased latency or stalled streams." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2419994321
Product_PM: Impacted SLAs? We need to capture customers hit for CS escalation. Laura, can you paste list?
Laura_support: Affected customers (prelim): "voiceflow-inc", "docsify", "sentry-copy". I've opened follow-up tickets and cc'd account reps.
Jane_runtime: Observed one streaming stall pattern: clients with longer prefix + large KV cache invalidation experienced repeat reconnects. Temporary fix: force keepalive pings and extend socket grace to 30s to avoid client-side retries turning into duplicate workloads.
Alice_SRE: Metrics snapshot (pre->during->post-mitigate):
- p95 baseline: 120ms -> incident peak: 550ms -> after routing: 210ms
- p99 baseline: 980ms -> incident peak: 4200ms -> after routing: 1400ms
- error rate for streaming: 0.01% -> 0.8% -> 0.05%
Jane_runtime: Also enabled fallback model policy in the control plane so if any node reports >10% queue growth we flip to quantized-gantry-13 automatically for new sessions. That prevents cascading backlog.
infra-bot: Node gpupool-usw2-47 drain completed, pods evicted. Node cordoned.
Mike_hw: Running vendor diag via remote console: nvdiag logs being uploaded to /var/logs/hw/gpupool-usw2-47/nvdiag-2419994321.tar.gz. Starting power-cycle attempt now (soft).
Alice_SRE: Handoff: Bob_oncall will take next 2-hour watch. I'm documenting actions and handing off active runbook. Bob, please monitor p99 and ECC counters and coordinate swap if memtest fails.
Bob_oncall: Taking handoff. Confirmed router exclusion and fallback policy. I'll keep periodic p99 snapshots and update every 15m.
Mike_hw: Update: soft power-cycle cleared transient ECC increments for ~6 minutes but counts started climbing again. Memtest indicates intermittent correctable error patterns localized to GPU0 channel B. Scheduling board replacement with vendor for hot-swap. ETA vendor tech 3 hours.
Jane_runtime: Because swap ETA is 3h, we've extended fallback routing and set quantized canary at 60% and reduced max streaming concurrency per node by 20% to keep SLO. Also flagged model-eval alerts for potential quality regressions.
Laura_support: Sent customer update: brief note about mitigation and expected next update in 3 hours. Escalation to enterprise customers done.
Product_PM: Postmortem please. Need root-cause check: hardware + thermal + kernel interactions. Also quantify cost of fallbacks for billing reconciliation.
Alice_SRE: Agreed — will open postmortem ticket once vendor swap completes. For now severity stays SEV2 until board replaced and ECC counters stable.
Bob_oncall: Next updates: p99 at 15m -> 720ms, error rate down to 0.12%. Will push final status once swap done.
incident-bot: Reminder: file an incident report in /incidents and tag "hardware-throttle" "streaming-tail" "SRE-oncall".
Alice_SRE: Thanks team. Good triage; clean handoff to Bob. I'll follow up with postmortem draft after vendor completes swap and we validate stable ECC stats.
